history.content: Lookup: Wikipedia (2020) on "Ice cream" legal definitions (United States). Summary: In the U.S., ice cream must contain at least 10% milk fat (butterfat) by weight. Other categories (e.g., "reduced fat" or "light") have different definitions, but the baseline for products labeled "ice cream" is 10% minimum. This aligns with long-standing federal standards.

- US federal standard (Wikipedia 2020) = 10.0%.
- Difference = 14.6% − 10.0% = +4.6%.
